name: Thunder Lizard Blood
summary: In the southern Barrens, hunters bring back Thunder Lizard Blood as proof of survival. The blood comes from the great beasts that roam the plains.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: Thunder lizards go by the names Stormsnouts, Stormhides, and Thunderheads across the plains. Their heavy steps shake the earth, and their crushing weight can flatten unwary hunters. Bringing back their blood shows the skill to hunt them and the endurance to survive beneath their thundering feet.

aliases: where to get thunder lizard blood
faq.answer: Stormsnouts, Stormhides, and Thunderheads provide the blood. These mature thunder lizards roam the savannah around Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens.

faq.q: Why is Thunder Lizard Blood sought after?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo asks hunters to gather the blood as part of trials across the Barrens. Bringing it back unbroken proves a hunter can face Kalimdor's largest stomping beasts.

faq.q: Where are these thunder lizards usually found?
faq.answer: Thunder lizards roam the grasslands north, east, and south of Camp Taurajo, grazing alongside the other large animals of the southern Barrens.

angles.text: As a hunter, you need steady footing and agility to best a thunder lizard. Taking its blood proves your mastery of the savannah's largest beasts.
As a tauren hunter from Camp Taurajo, you face thunder lizards in a traditional test of survival alongside the formidable giants of your homeland.
